# 05 Expose prev() through render(), confirm new diagnostics propagate

## Outcome

`render()`'s returned controller carries a working `prev()`, exercised end to end through the real
parser → graph-model → layout → renderer → animation pipeline (no fixtures below the
`TextMeasurer` seam). New graph-model diagnostics (visibility-precondition violations) surface in
`result.diagnostics`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A source document using all four verbs (`enter`, `exit`, `highlight`, `unhighlight`) and at
  least one `slide-*` effect renders successfully end to end through `render()`.
- [ ] Calling `result.controller.next()` several times then `result.controller.prev()` once
  produces the class state matching one fewer `next()` call, through the real pipeline (not a
  fixture) — same contract as ticket 04, now proven through the public seam.
- [ ] A source with a `highlight` action referencing an element before it becomes visible produces
  the expected error diagnostic in `result.diagnostics`; `render()` does not throw and the rest of
  the diagram still renders.

## Test seam

`render(source: string, container: HTMLElement): SirenRenderResult` — jsdom integration test, real
modules, same pattern as the first slice's ticket 06.
